rows.note: Use this everyday construction when the disparagement is expressed by speaking badly about A.

example.english: They constantly disparage other people; it is really uncouth.
example.traditional: 佢成日講人哋壞話，真係好冇品。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 jan4 dei6 waai6 waa6 zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 ban2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for regarding someone or something as inferior or less worthy.

example.english: Do not disparage yourself; you will succeed if you take it step by step.
example.traditional: 你唔好睇低自己，慢慢嚟一定得。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 dai1 zi6 gei2 maan6 maan2 lai4 jat1 ding6 dak1

rows.note: Use this when deliberately lowering someone's status, value, or estimation, especially in more formal discussion.

example.english: We should not disparage the contributions of frontline employees in the report.
example.traditional: 喺份報告入面，唔應該貶低基層員工嘅貢獻。
example.jyutping: hai2 fan6 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 m4 jing1 goi1 bin2 dai1 gei1 cang4 jyun4 gung1 ge3 gung3 hin3
